inputs.text: South Portland’s schools are preparing to cut more than 70 positions, and families deserve a plain accounting—not another round of excuses. A school system’s first duty is to educate children and support the people who teach them, not protect administrative priorities. Taxpayers have a right to know how this happened and who is accountable. Careful stewardship, clear priorities, and respect for families should come before bureaucratic comfort.
